A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RDD work and provide readable text, equations, figures and tables for reliable comparison. Both contain 10 pages ending with references; neither includes the supplementary material mentioned in the text.

before.justification: Sections 4.1–4.4 report original pose-estimation, homography-estimation, visual-localization and ablation results in Tables 1–5, supplemented by qualitative matching examples.

after.justification: V2 retains the original experimental results in Tables 1–5 and the qualitative comparisons, with one revised baseline example in Figure 3.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Figure 2 retain the same two-branch architecture, deformable attention, sparse and semi-dense matching procedures, refinement module and training losses.

E1.justification: Coverage remains MegaDepth, MegaDepth-1500, MegaDepth-View, Air-to-Ground, HPatches and Aachen Day-Night, with unchanged training and evaluation tasks. Figure 3 retains the same image pairs.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in Tables 1–4 and Figure 3 is unchanged. ALIKED remains a comparator in the revised Figure 3 panel; its displayed outcome changes.

E3.justification: The reported splits, image resolutions, feature budgets, training settings, metrics and evaluation procedures remain unchanged. No protocol revision accompanies the Figure 3 update.

E4.justification: Figure 3 revises the existing qualitative error comparison for ALIKED on the first MegaDepth-1500 example, replacing a duplicated visualization with distinct matching evidence. Section 4.4 and Table 5 retain all ablations unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests or comparable uncertainty estimates. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: In Figure 3's first MegaDepth-1500 example, ALIKED's displayed results change from 4,546 matches and 81.7% precision (3,714/4,546) to 1,300 matches and 67.9% precision (883/1,300). The displayed e_t/e_R values change from 0.73/0.98 to 3.32/1.79. All aggregate results in Tables 1–5 remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(20), including the attention definitions, epipolar refinement derivation and loss formulations, are mathematically unchanged. Page 6 differences concern positioning and spacing.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about geometric robustness, sparse matching performance, semi-dense matching capability and dataset contributions.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Section 5 retains the limitations concerning absent explicit training augmentation and dependence on reliable sparse correspondences for semi-dense refinement.

D1.justification: Architecture hyperparameters, optimizer and learning-rate schedule, hardware, training times, data-processing information and project-page access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 retains the same research positioning and discussion of earlier methods. All 48 references are unchanged.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date marker changes from v1, 12 May 2025, to v2, 18 June 2025. The title, authors, scientific prose, captions and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1 and 3 receive limited changes to sizing, spacing and label styling. Figure 3 also replaces the ALIKED panel and slightly shifts the surrounding page layout. Figure 2 and Tables 1–5 retain their displays.

improvement.justification: V1's ALIKED panel for the first MegaDepth-1500 example is identical to its XFeat* panel. V2 replaces it with a distinct visualization and statistics, resolving that internal duplication and improving the reliability of one qualitative comparison. The method, aggregate experimental evidence and conclusions remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
